name: feature.recommendations.nodes
description: Recommendations feature node pack (MERCH-A chat-drivability) — read/author nodes over the ctx.features.recommendations surface. `resolve` returns ranked products for a funnel slot; `placement-upsert` authors a slot→source placement. `resolve` is a read (role:'action', which re-executes on replay; a caller that needs the exact products records them in its own output, ruling 7). `placement-upsert` writes, so it is role:'side-effect' and :fork serves its recorded output (ADR 1025 D2).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Recommendations Resolve
nodes.description: Resolves ranked products for a funnel slot (pdp/cart/post_purchase/…) over ctx.features.recommendations. A read; re-executes on replay over the mutable recs cache. Inputs: orgId, slot, productId?, contactId?, sessionKey?.

nodes.label: Recommendations Placement Upsert
nodes.description: Authors a placement (slot → recommendation source, optional segment + holdout) over ctx.features.recommendations. role:'side-effect' (ADR 1025 D2); idempotent by effect on (slot, segmentId) for rows this lane authored. Inputs: orgId, slot, source, segmentId?, holdoutPct?.
